People: ʻAbdu'l-Bahá (author, Wikidata Q216954), died 1921. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("ʻAbdu'l-Bahá, 1844-1921") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Abdul Baha in London ; addresses, & notes of conversations, East Sheen, Surrey : The Unity press for the Bahai publishing society; London : J. M. Watkins, agent, 1912, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/abdulbahainlondo0000abdu. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 100%, 100%, 88% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of ʻAbdu'l-Bahá, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
